ucs.title: [LLM] APT32 (OceanLotus / Canvas Cyclone) DLL side-loading via signed AV/Adobe host binaries in user-writeable paths
ucs.description: Hunts the signature OceanLotus tradecraft of dropping a legitimately-signed Symantec/McAfee/Kaspersky/Adobe utility (RasTls.exe, wsc_proxy.exe, McOemCpy.exe, AcroTranscoder.exe, gup.exe, KAVUpd.exe, etc.) into AppData/Temp/Downloads/ProgramData so it side-loads a co-located malicious DLL (KerrDown / METALJACK / DENIES loader). The legit binary itself is unusual to see executing from a user-writeable directory and is APT32's most-repeated initial-execution pattern across Mandiant and CrowdStrike clusters (Ocean Buffalo / BISMUTH).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent values(Processes.process_hash) as hash from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("wsc_proxy.exe","rastls.exe","rastlsc.exe","mcoemcpy.exe","mcvsshld.exe","acrotranscoder.exe","mcods.exe","gup.exe","kavupd.exe","frame.exe","goopdate.exe") AND (Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Downloads\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Roaming\\*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let APT32SideloadHosts = dynamic(["wsc_proxy.exe","rastls.exe","rastlsc.exe","mcoemcpy.exe","mcvsshld.exe","acrotranscoder.exe","mcods.exe","gup.exe","kavupd.exe","frame.exe","goopdate.exe"]);
let SuspectPaths = dynamic([@"\AppData\", @"\Temp\", @"\Downloads\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Public\", @"\Roaming\"]);
let SideloadHostExec = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName in~ (APT32SideloadHosts)
    | where FolderPath has_any (SuspectPaths)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, HostBin=FileName, HostPath=FolderPath, ProcessId, SHA256;
SideloadHostExec
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName endswith ".dll"
    | where FolderPath has_any (SuspectPaths)
    | project DllTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, InitiatingProcessId, LoadedDll=FileName, DllPath=FolderPath, DllSHA256=SHA256
  ) on DeviceId, $left.ProcessId == $right.InitiatingProcessId
| where isempty(LoadedDll) or DllPath =~ HostPath  // co-located DLL = textbook side-load
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, HostBin, HostPath, LoadedDll, DllPath, DllSHA256, HostSHA256=SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let APT32SideloadHosts = dynamic(["wsc_proxy.exe","rastls.exe","rastlsc.exe","mcoemcpy.exe","mcvsshld.exe","acrotranscoder.exe","mcods.exe","gup.exe","kavupd.exe","frame.exe","goopdate.exe"]);
let SuspectPaths = dynamic([@"\AppData\", @"\Temp\", @"\Downloads\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Public\", @"\Roaming\"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend BinName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where BinName in (APT32SideloadHosts)
| where NewProcessName has_any (SuspectPaths)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT32 (OceanLotus) Signed Side-Load Host Executing from User-Writeable Path
id: 8f3b1a72-7c4e-4d1a-9d22-3c0b1e8a0a01
status: experimental
description: Detects legitimately-signed third-party utilities (Symantec RasTls, McAfee McOemCpy, Adobe AcroTranscoder, etc.) that APT32/OceanLotus repeatedly abuses for DLL side-loading, when launched from AppData, Temp, Downloads, ProgramData, Public, or Roaming. These binaries should only ever execute from their canonical install paths under Program Files.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050/
  - https://www.mandiant.com/resources/blog/cyber-espionage-apt32
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/18
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.g0050
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\wsc_proxy.exe'
      - '\rastls.exe'
      - '\rastlsc.exe'
      - '\mcoemcpy.exe'
      - '\mcvsshld.exe'
      - '\acrotranscoder.exe'
      - '\mcods.exe'
      - '\gup.exe'
      - '\kavupd.exe'
      - '\frame.exe'
      - '\goopdate.exe'
  selection_path:
    Image|contains:
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - '\Downloads\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Public\'
      - '\Roaming\'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Vendor installer staged in a non-standard path by IT
  - Portable AV updater testing
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\wsc_proxy.exe OR *\\WSC_PROXY.EXE OR *\\rastls.exe OR *\\RasTls.exe OR *\\RASTLS.EXE OR *\\rastlsc.exe OR *\\RasTlsc.exe OR *\\mcoemcpy.exe OR *\\McOemCpy.exe OR *\\mcvsshld.exe OR *\\McVsShld.exe OR *\\acrotranscoder.exe OR *\\AcroTranscoder.exe OR *\\mcods.exe OR *\\McOds.exe OR *\\gup.exe OR *\\GUP.exe OR *\\kavupd.exe OR *\\KAVUpd.exe OR *\\frame.exe OR *\\Frame.exe OR *\\goopdate.exe OR *\\GoogleUpdate.exe) AND @Image:(*\\AppData\\* OR *\\appdata\\* OR *\\Temp\\* OR *\\temp\\* OR *\\TEMP\\* OR *\\Downloads\\* OR *\\downloads\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\programdata\\* OR *\\Public\\* OR *\\Roaming\\* OR *\\roaming\\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(wsc_proxy|rastls|rastlsc|mcoemcpy|mcvsshld|acrotranscoder|mcods|gup|kavupd|frame|goopdate)\.exe$/i
| regex("\\\\(AppData|Temp|Downloads|ProgramData|Public|Roaming)\\\\", field=ImageFileName)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData], function=count())

ucs.title: [LLM] APT32 KerrDown / CACTUSTORCH chain: Office macro spawning rundll32 with side-load DLL export from user-writeable path
ucs.description: Hunts the OceanLotus phishing-to-beacon chain: Vietnamese-language lure (.doc/.docx/.xls) opens, macro spawns rundll32.exe pointing at a DLL in AppData/Temp/ProgramData with a giveaway export name (DllRegisterServer, Entry, Start, OpenW, OpenL, #1) that loads the Cobalt Strike / Denis backdoor stager, followed by outbound HTTPS to a public IP within seconds. This Office→rundll32→C2 sequence is the documented APT32 'KerrDown' delivery pattern (Mandiant UNC, CrowdStrike Ocean Buffalo, Microsoft BISMUTH).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.process_id) as pid values(Processes.process_hash) as hash from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe") AND Processes.process_name="rundll32.exe" AND (Processes.process="*.dll,DllRegisterServer*" OR Processes.process="*.dll,Entry*" OR Processes.process="*.dll,Start*" OR Processes.process="*.dll,Run*" OR Processes.process="*.dll,OpenW*" OR Processes.process="*.dll,OpenL*" OR Processes.process="*.dll,#1*" OR Processes.process="*\\AppData\\*.dll*" OR Processes.process="*\\Temp\\*.dll*" OR Processes.process="*\\ProgramData\\*.dll*" OR Processes.process="*\\Public\\*.dll*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process Processes.process_id _time | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | rename process_id as pid_rundll | join type=inner dest pid_rundll [| tstats summariesonly=true count as conn_count values(All_Traffic.dest_ip) as remote_ip values(All_Traffic.dest_port) as remote_port from datamodel=Network_Traffic.All_Traffic where All_Traffic.app="rundll32.exe" by All_Traffic.src All_Traffic.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name("All_Traffic")` | rename src as dest process_id as pid_rundll] | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let OfficeParents = dynamic(["winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe"]);
let SuspectExports = dynamic([".dll,DllRegisterServer",".dll,Entry",".dll,Start",".dll,Run",".dll,OpenW",".dll,OpenL",".dll,#1"]);
let SuspectDllPaths = dynamic([@"\AppData\", @"\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Public\", @"\Downloads\"]);
let RunDllSpawn = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ (OfficeParents)
    | where FileName =~ "rundll32.exe"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (SuspectExports)
       or ProcessCommandLine has_any (SuspectDllPaths)
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project SpawnTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName,
              OfficeParent=InitiatingProcessFileName,
              OfficeCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              RunDllCmd=ProcessCommandLine,
              RunDllPid=ProcessId;
RunDllSpawn
| join kind=inner (
    DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "rundll32.exe"
    | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
    | where ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess"
    | project NetTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, InitiatingProcessId, RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl
  ) on DeviceId, $left.RunDllPid == $right.InitiatingProcessId
| where NetTime between (SpawnTime .. SpawnTime + 5m)
| project SpawnTime, NetTime, DelaySec=datetime_diff('second', NetTime, SpawnTime),
          DeviceName, AccountName, OfficeParent, RunDllCmd, RemoteIP, RemotePort, RemoteUrl
| order by SpawnTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let OfficeParents = dynamic(["winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe"]);
let SuspectExports = dynamic([".dll,DllRegisterServer",".dll,Entry",".dll,Start",".dll,Run",".dll,OpenW",".dll,OpenL",".dll,#1"]);
let SuspectDllPaths = dynamic([@"\AppData\", @"\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Public\", @"\Downloads\"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ParentBin = tolower(tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| extend NewBin = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ParentBin in (OfficeParents)
| where NewBin == "rundll32.exe"
| where CommandLine has_any (SuspectExports) or CommandLine has_any (SuspectDllPaths)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, NewProcessId
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: APT32 KerrDown Office-to-Rundll32 Side-Load Chain
id: a17e4f2c-3b9e-4a2b-9c5e-2f81d4a1bb02
status: experimental
description: Detects OceanLotus / APT32 KerrDown delivery pattern where an Office application spawns rundll32.exe pointing at a DLL in a user-writeable directory with a side-load-style export name (DllRegisterServer, Entry, Start, OpenW, #1).
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050/
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/tracking-oceanlotus-new-downloader-kerrdown/
author: Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/18
tags:

  - attack.t1218.011
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.g0050
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\powerpnt.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
  selection_export:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '.dll,DllRegisterServer'

      - '.dll,Start'
      - '.dll,Run'
      - '.dll,OpenW'
      - '.dll,OpenL'
      - '.dll,#1'
  selection_path:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Public\'
      - '\Downloads\'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and (selection_export or selection_path)
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate Office add-in installers (rare; usually run from Program Files)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\winword.exe OR *\\WINWORD.EXE OR *\\excel.exe OR *\\EXCEL.EXE OR *\\powerpnt.exe OR *\\POWERPNT.EXE OR *\\outlook.exe OR *\\OUTLOOK.EXE) AND @Image:(*\\rundll32.exe OR *\\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\\Rundll32.exe) AND @CommandLine:(*DllRegisterServer* OR *,Entry* OR *,Start* OR *,Run* OR *,OpenW* OR *,OpenL* OR *,#1* OR *\\AppData\\* OR *\\Temp\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\Public\\* OR *\\Downloads\\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^(winword|excel|powerpnt|outlook)\.exe$/i ImageFileName=/\\rundll32\.exe$/i
| regex("\\.dll,(DllRegisterServer|Entry|Start|Run|OpenW|OpenL|#1)|\\\\(AppData|Temp|ProgramData|Public|Downloads)\\\\.+\\.dll", field=CommandLine)
